Set up Google sign-in for BigQuery

Source: R/backend__bigquery.R
oauth_db_bigquery_client.Rd

Create a sign-in client for a Shiny app that queries BigQuery. Pass it to shinyOAuth's UI and server modules, then query with oauth_db_bigquery_api().

Usage

oauth_db_bigquery_client(
  client_id,
  redirect_uri,
  client_secret,
  ...,
  provider = shinyOAuth::oauth_provider_google(),
  scopes = c("openid", "profile", "email", "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery")
)

Arguments

client_id

Application ID from the OAuth registration.

redirect_uri

Registered URL where the browser returns after sign-in.

client_secret

Client secret from a Google Web OAuth registration.

...

Other arguments for shinyOAuth::oauth_client().

provider

Custom shinyOAuth provider, replacing the default.

scopes

OAuth scopes to request, replacing the defaults.

Value

A shinyOAuth OAuthClient. Create it outside server().

Details

Register a Web OAuth client in Google Cloud. Users need access to the query project and datasets.

See also

oauth_db_bigquery_api(). vignette("bigquery", package = "shinyOAuthDB") has sign-in setup and a complete app.

Other sign-in configuration: oauth_db_databricks_client(), oauth_db_databricks_provider(), oauth_db_microsoft_client(), oauth_db_snowflake_client(), oauth_db_snowflake_provider()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
client <- oauth_db_bigquery_client(
  client_id = Sys.getenv("OAUTHDB_CLIENT_ID"),
  client_secret = Sys.getenv("OAUTHDB_CLIENT_SECRET"),
  redirect_uri = "http://localhost:8100"
)
} # }
